# The laws of one step / 一步的规律

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`laws-of-one-step` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](laws-of-one-step.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Each law holds of every world, with the condition its proof uses stated inside it as a fact about that world at the steps and relata used: balance at a step fixes coming to stand and ceasing to stand, running down fixes and bounds change, and a list covering what holds ties ceasing to arising.
>
> 每条规律对每个世界成立，证明所用的条件写在规律之内，是该世界在所用步与关系项上的事实：一步上的平衡定下开始立着与不再立着，下降定下并约束变化，覆盖成立者的列表把不再成立连到开始成立。

## Laws / 规律

1. Balance at a step: the flow balances on a family across a step where each member's level after it, with what was taken from it, is its level before with what was given to it; balance is balance on every family across every step.<br>一步的平衡：流跨过一步在一个家族上平衡，指每个成员步后的水平连同被取的等于步前的水平连同被给的；平衡就是每一步、每个家族上的平衡。 (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn`, `Becoming.Flow.balances_iff_on`)
2. With balance at a condition across a step, it comes to stand exactly when it stood at nothing and was given more than was taken from it, and ceases to stand exactly when it stood and what was taken from it is all it had with all it was given.<br>一个条件跨过一步平衡时，它开始立着恰当此前立在零且被给的多于被取的，不再立着恰当此前立着且被取的等于它所有的连同被给的。 (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.comesToStand_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.ceasesToStand_iff`)
3. Across a step at which nothing is taken from a balanced family, a member rises exactly when something taking part gives to it, which dissipation on the family excludes.<br>跨过没有从平衡的家族取用的一步，成员上升恰当有参与者给予它，家族上的耗散排除这一点。 (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.rises_iff_gives`, `Becoming.Flow.DissipatesOn.still_untaken`)
4. Arising needs an active giver: a relatum embodied at both ends of the step and given to only by active formations arises exactly when it comes to stand, so as an active giver other than itself gives to it.<br>生起需要活跃的给予者：在一步两端都体现、只有活跃者给予它的关系项，生起恰当开始立着，所以由一个不是它自己的活跃给予者给予。 (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.arises_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.arises_given`)
5. Nothing comes to stand from nothing across a step at which a family holding it is balanced and dissipated on.<br>跨过包含它的家族被平衡与耗散的一步，没有什么从无中开始立着。 (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.comes_from_standing`)
6. Rest: a family runs down across a step where it holds, without repetition, whatever stands before or after the step, and the flow balances and dissipates on it, with no closure; then some condition's standing changes exactly when the family's total falls, and, with the family closed, something taking part takes or gives exactly then.<br>静止：家族不重复地包含步前或步后立着的每个条件、流在它上面平衡并耗散时（不需要封闭），称它跨过该步下降；这时有条件的水平改变恰当家族的总水平下降，家族也封闭时有参与者取用或给予也恰在此时。 (`Becoming.Flow.RunsDownOn`, `Becoming.Flow.RunsDownOn.changes_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.RunsDownOn.exchanges_iff`)
7. Continued change needs openness, exactly: under a census of what stands, standing changes at arbitrarily late steps exactly when it changes at arbitrarily late steps across which what stands does not run down, and so with the exchange and closure.<br>持续变化需要开放，取确切形式：所立者有普查时，水平在任意晚的步改变，恰当它在任意晚的、所立者不下降的步上改变；交换连同封闭亦然。 (`Becoming.Flow.change_recurs_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.exchange_recurs_iff`)
8. The general form of recurrence: where under a condition an event lowers an amount, the amount never rises under the condition, and every rise of it is the event, the event recurs exactly where it recurs without the condition, by a bounded search with no decision.<br>复现的一般形式：在条件之下事件使一个量下降、这个量不上升、它的每次上升都是事件时，事件复现恰当它在不满足条件的步上复现，搜索有界，不用判定。 (`Becoming.recurs_iff_unmet`)
9. Running down bounds change: over any stretch, with no condition, what stands at its end with the steps at which the total standing fell number at most the total at its start with all it rose.<br>下降约束变化：任何一段步上，不加条件，末步立着的连同总水平下降的步不多于首步的总水平连同它上升的全部。 (`Becoming.Flow.standing_bounds_change`)
10. The total rises only across steps that do not run down, so across steps that run down what stands at the end with the steps at which some standing changed is within the total at the start, with no decision of whether a standing changed.<br>总水平只在不下降的步上上升，所以在下降的各步上，末步立着的连同有水平改变的步不多于首步的总水平，不判定水平是否改变。 (`Becoming.Flow.runsDown_bounds_change`, `Becoming.Flow.runsDown_change_bound`)
11. Ceasing needs arising: a list covers what holds at a step where every member holding there is on it; for any finite list, what holds of it at the end of a stretch with its ceasings is what held of it at the start exactly when none of it comes to be across the stretch.<br>不再存在需要生起：一个列表覆盖一步上成立者，指那里每个成立的成员都在它上面；对任何有限列表，段末它成立的连同这一段的不再成立，等于段首它成立的，恰当这一段它没有成员开始成立。 (`Becoming.Covers`, `Becoming.cohort_closes_iff`)
12. With a list holding exactly what holds at N and nothing coming to be after N, what holds at the end with what ceased since N number exactly those holding at N.<br>列表恰好列出第 N 步成立者、N 之后没有开始成立时，段末成立的连同自 N 以来不再成立的恰好等于第 N 步成立的数目。 (`Becoming.ListsAt`, `Becoming.ceasing_needs_arising`)
13. Ceasing recurring needs coming to be recurring wherever some list covers what holds at arbitrarily late steps, a census being the case of covering every step.<br>只要在任意晚的步有列表覆盖成立者，不再成立的复现就需要开始成立的复现；普查是覆盖每一步的情形。 (`Becoming.coming_of_ceasing_covered`, `Becoming.Listed.covered`)
14. With no decision, where a list covers step N and nothing comes to be after it, ceasing does not recur.<br>不用判定时，列表覆盖第 N 步、此后没有开始成立，不再成立就不复现。 (`Becoming.Covers.ceasing_not_recurring`, `Becoming.Covers.not_not_coming_from`)
15. Corollaries: a premise selected for every step makes each condition hold everywhere, so the selection results follow, their statements unchanged and their proofs through these laws: the openness module's rest theorems, the premises supplying the condition, ceasing needing arising for worlds and standing censuses, the active giver of an embodied relatum, and the enclosure and binding laws of counting and standing.<br>推论：对每一步都选的前提使各条件处处成立，所以选择结果随之成立，陈述不变，证明改经这些规律：开放模块的静止定理（条件由前提给出）、世界与立者普查上不再成立需要生起、体现关系项的活跃给予者，以及计数与立着的封闭与约束定律。 (`Becoming.Flow.change_stops_unrefuted_around`, `Becoming.Flow.exchange_not_recurring_around`, `Becoming.Flow.standing_never_rises`, `Becoming.Flow.change_lowers`, `Becoming.Flow.AroundStanding.runsDownClosed`, `Becoming.World.arising_of_ceasing`, `Becoming.Web.StandingCensus.coming_of_ceasing`, `Becoming.Web.Embodied.arises_given`, `Becoming.World.enclosure_bounds_change`, `Becoming.World.taking_binds_counting`, `Becoming.World.enclosed_binds_counting`, `Becoming.World.enclosure_bounds_standing`, `Becoming.World.enclosed_binds_standing`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No global premise: the condition of each law is stated inside it, as a fact about the world at the steps and relata where the proof uses it (balance and dissipation on a family across a step, the embodiment of a relatum, a list at some steps).<br>无全局前提：每条规律的条件写在规律之内，是关于该世界在证明用到它的那些步与关系项上的事实（某一步、某个家族上的平衡与耗散，某个关系项的体现，某些步上的列表）。
- A census of what stands: the recurrence laws and running down bounding change use it, only to make the total standing a number at each step; it is a local condition at the steps of a tail, not a global premise. The laws of one step need no census.<br>所立者的普查：复现定律与下降约束变化用它，作用只是使每步的总水平是一个数；它是尾段各步上的局部条件，不是全局前提。一步的规律不需要普查。
- Representation: discrete steps and natural-number amounts; the least difference in dissipation (the sign term, Ren's option A), which the recurrence of continued change and the bounds on change use; the exact count of ceasing needing arising uses marks (deciding what holds), its form that ceasing does not recur none. These are commitments of the representation, not premises on worlds.<br>表示：离散的步与自然数的量；耗散中的最小差异（sign 项，Ren 选定的 A），持续变化的复现与变化的界用它；不再存在需要生起的确切计数用标记（判定成立），它的不复现形式不用判定。这些是表示的承诺，不是世界的前提。

## Does not show / 未表明

- No premise is derived: the move is localization, not a re-founding of the representation, within which the premises remain contingent and independent.<br>不推出任何前提：所作的是局部化，不是重新奠定表示；表示之内各前提仍是偶然的、彼此独立的。
- Running down bounds change by an inequality, not an iff; the exact form is the identity over a stretch together with the one-step iffs.<br>下降约束变化是不等式而非当且仅当；确切形式是一段上的恒等式连同一步的当且仅当。
- The recurrence laws and the bound need a census of what stands at the steps of a tail; dropping it where infinitely many stand would change the representation of amounts, which is Ren's decision.<br>复现定律与该界在尾段各步用所立者的普查；要在无穷多立着时去掉它，须改变量的表示，属于 Ren 的决定。
- Whether each law survives amounts finer than whole units is not tested here; for rest, the resolution result covers it.<br>各条在超出整单位的量下是否成立，在此未检验；静止由分辨率一线覆盖。
- Coarser steps and continuous time are not covered.<br>不涵盖较粗的步与连续时间。
- Closure is not what bounds change: the proof shows that running down does, closure being how the premises supply it; the name ‘closure bounds change’ is Ren's.<br>约束变化的不是封闭：证明表明是下降，封闭是前提给出下降的方式；“封闭约束变化”的名称是 Ren 的。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** World.sourcedQueue: the flow balances and is dissipative (which binds only closed families), yet members come to stand from nothing; by Flow.BalancesOn.comes_from_standing no family holding such a member is dissipated on across that step. So the local condition is dissipation on a family holding the relatum, which the premise supplies only where that family is closed.<br>World.sourcedQueue：流平衡、满足耗散（只约束封闭的家族），成员却从无中开始立着；由 Flow.BalancesOn.comes_from_standing，那一步上没有包含它的家族被耗散。所以局部条件是包含该关系项的家族上的耗散；前提只在家族封闭处给出它。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Standing.lean)
- **Counterexample / 反例:** Listed.lpo_of_few: the form in which ceasing does not recur needs no decision, but naming an explicit last step needs omniscience in general; so continued change needing openness and ceasing needing arising are stated as negated recurrences.<br>Listed.lpo_of_few：不再成立不复现的形式不用判定，但给出明确的最后一步一般地需要全知；所以持续变化需要开放与不再存在需要生起以复现的否定陈述。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Openness.lean)

**Standard boundaries / 通用边界:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. 不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. 不含伦理谓词，不评价生起或消失。 · Stated for discrete steps. 按离散步骤陈述。 · Names follow Ren's naming criteria of 10 October 2026; readings remain Ren's. 名称依 Ren 2026年10月10日的命名标准；读法由 Ren 决定。

### Correspondence / 对应

The selection theorems ask which laws the counts obey under a selection of the eight premises. Following Ren's redirect, this result asks instead what each law needs, at which steps and relata of the world. The proofs show the conditions are local: the laws of one step use balance only at that step and condition; rest uses only a family holding what stands running down across those steps, with no closure; running down bounds the change of what stands with no embodiment; ceasing needs arising uses only a list covering what holds, with no census. Where the premises hold at every step, these conditions hold at every step, so the selection results are corollaries. Reading (AI, pending Ren): the laws of Part I that the premises bound are laws of each step and its relata, and the premises are one way of making their conditions hold everywhere.<br>选择定理问的是：在八个前提的某个选择之下，计数服从哪些规律。按 Ren 的转向，本结果改问：每条规律在世界的哪些步与关系项上需要什么。证明表明所需的条件都是局部的：一步的规律只用该步、该条件上的平衡；静止只用跨过那些步、包含所立者的家族的下降，不需要封闭；下降约束变化对所立者不需要体现；不再存在需要生起只用覆盖成立者的列表，不需要普查。前提对每一步成立时，这些条件在每一步成立，选择结果因此是推论。读法（AI，待 Ren）：前提约束的第一部分规律，是每一步及其关系项的规律；前提是使它们的条件处处成立的一种方式。
